name: – Nils Ušakovs – After § 1 – Am 45
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 1a. Takes the view that the European Union budget should promote public investment by supporting productive and strategic sectors, public services, the creation of jobs with rights, in order to achieve full employment, eradicate poverty, social exclusion and inequalities, protect the environment and biodiversity, fully use of the potential of individual countries and regions, support the reception and integration of refugees and migrants, together with the pursuit of external relations rooted in solidarity, cooperation, mutual respect and peace;
